scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.lint: ruby -c lib/data_importer.rb && bash -n scripts/db/*.sh && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w packages/shared
scripts.test: npm run db:check && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
